name: I Suddenly Became a Magical Girl to Fight Aliens from Another Dimension?!
source:
I Suddenly Became A Magical Girl To Fight Aliens From Another Dimension, or I Suddenly Became A Magical Girl is a visual novel made for Yuri Jam 2016.

Follow Kagami, a high school student who gets her wish to become a magical girl granted! A life full of sparkly attacks and swishing silk ribbons awaits her...

...as well preventing an entire civilization of bug-like aliens from destroying Earth.

But hey, that's just part of the job!

[From [url=https://madocallie.itch.io/isuddenlybecameamagicalgirl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《I Suddenly Became A Magical Girl To Fight Aliens From Another Dimension》，簡稱《I Suddenly Became A Magical Girl》，是一部為Yuri Jam 2016製作的視覺小說。

跟隨高中生Kagami的腳步，見證她成為魔法少女的願望實現！閃閃發光的招式、飛舞的緞帶，這樣的生活正在等著她……

……當然，她還得阻止整個蟲形外星文明毀滅地球。

不過，這也是工作的一部分嘛！

（來源：[url=https://madocallie.itch.io/isuddenlybecameamagicalgirl]itch.io[/url]）
